description: Implement support for multiple object storage providers (S3, R2, etc.) with seamless migration capabilities. The system should allow configuration of a default storage protocol for new runs while maintaining backward compatibility for existing runs that use the legacy object store. Developers should be able to add new storage providers through environment variable configuration.
functional_requirements: Support configuration of a default object storage protocol via OBJECT_STORE_DEFAULT_PROTOCOL environment variable
Implement provider-specific configuration using protocol-prefixed environment variables (e.g., OBJECT_STORE_S3_* for S3, OBJECT_STORE_R2_* for R2)
Ensure existing runs with offloaded payloads continue using the legacy object store without disruption
Route new run payloads and outputs to the configured default storage provider
Update API endpoints and packet handling to work with multiple storage providers
Include documentation updates for self-hosting configurations and environment variable setup
